Proof of Work: Digital Inventory & Movement Tracking for Government Press and Stationery

Submitted for NESFIC26 problem statement D-39, posted by the Directorate of Printing & Stationery, Department of Information, Public Relations, Printing & Stationery, Government of Assam.

MudraKosh digitises the end-to-end inflow, warehouse storage, press machinery consumption, and departmental distribution of paper, forms, gazettes and stationery. An append-only ledger guarantees stock accuracy, automated alerts eliminate stockouts, and cryptographic QR e-Challans provide verifiable proof of delivery across state offices.

Solution architecture and data flow Five layers, open standards, transactional integrity
Proof of Work

1. Inflow & Physical Gate

  • Paper Mill consignment delivery with PO invoice
  • Gate weighment slip recording gross & tare weight
  • Thermal barcode / QR printer for physical reel tags
  • Mobile camera QR scanner on warehouse floor

2. Ingestion & API Gateway

  • REST API with NestJS & DTO schema validation
  • Strict rate limiting & JWT / e-Pramaan SSO auth
  • CSV / Excel bulk opening stock import validator
  • Unit conversion engine: MT → Reels → Reams

3. Append-Only Ledger

  • PostgreSQL 16 with ACID transactional guarantees
  • Row-level locking: zero overselling under concurrency
  • Immutable ledger: no direct update/delete allowed
  • MinIO private object storage for PDF e-Challans

4. Press & Alert Engine

  • Press Job Work-Order material consumption tracker
  • Machine trimming & spoilage variance (CAG 3.5% norm)
  • Automated low-stock threshold monitor (30% / 15%)
  • Queue worker: SMS & email delivery alerts

5. Applications

  • Directorate Executive Web Portal (React & Tailwind)
  • Central Storekeeper Inventory & GRN interface
  • Assam Govt Press Floor production logger
  • Offline-capable PWA / CLI for Recipient DDO sign-off

Closed-Loop Reconciliation & Proof of Delivery

Every outbound dispatch is accompanied by a cryptographic QR e-Challan. When the recipient department scans upon delivery, the confirmation instantly syncs back to the central ledger, closing the transaction and archiving digital delivery proof.

Government Hosting

Docker containers deployed on MeitY-empanelled cloud or the Assam State Data Centre (SDC). All data stays in India.

Security & Compliance

TLS 1.3, AES-256 at rest, GIGW 3.0 accessibility, CERT-In VAPT audit before launch, and strict DPDP Act 2023 compliance.

Progressive Rollout

Level 1: Guwahati Store opening balances. Level 2: Press Floor job-tracking. Level 3: Multi-tenant rollout to Health & Education stores.

Proof of Work

Closed-Loop Operational Lifecycle: MudraKosh synchronizes 6 government personas across physical weighbridges, QR-tagged store bays, machine print lines, online departmental indenting, and mobile field dispatches with tamper-evident cryptographic sign-off.

● Physical Flow (MT/Reels) ● Cryptographic Audit (e-Challan) ● 100% Closed Loop
Stage 1 · Inward Inflow
Gate In & QC Verification
Gate Guard & Storekeeper
  • Mill consignment arrival with GeM PO
  • Digital weighbridge gross & tare logging
  • 3-step QC: GSM, tear, moisture testing
  • System auto-generates GRN-2026
  • Batch GS1 QR adhesive stickers printed
Artifact: Inward GRN & Bay QR
Stage 2 · Storage & Ledger
Warehouse Allocation & Ledger
Store Officer & Append Ledger
  • Physical reel slotting: Bay 2 / Rack B
  • ACID ledger increments instantly (+20 Reels)
  • Deterministic unit conversion (MT → Reams)
  • Automated Reorder Level (ROL) monitoring
  • Banners alert if stock drops <30% / <15%
Artifact: Perpetual Ledger Lock
Stage 3 · Press Conversion
Govt Press Floor & Spoilage
Press Supervisor & Operator
  • Gazette / Form job work-order linked
  • Mounted reel QR scanned at machine feeder
  • Daily production: 10,000 gazette copies
  • Trimming wastage tracked against 3.5% CAG
  • Unused paper returned via Return-to-Store
Artifact: WO Job Card & Spoilage Act
Stage 4 · Requisition
Department Indents & Sanction
Recipient DDO & DPS Director
  • Online catalog indent submitted by DC Office
  • System verifies annual quota entitlement
  • DPS Director reviews & grants 1-click sanction
  • Warehouse packs bundles & prints e-Challan
  • Cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 QR encoded
Artifact: e-Challan #CHL-2026
Stage 5 · Transit & PoD
Dispatch Exit & Mobile PoD
Driver & Recipient Nodal DDO
  • Gate security exit weighment & pass
  • Driver manifest navigates delivery route
  • Recipient DDO scans QR on mobile PWA
  • Digital sign-off on glass / OTP verification
  • Auto-Reconcile: Closes transit, syncs ledger
Artifact: Mobile Digital PoD

🛡️ 5 Zero-Leakage Decision Gates

Gate 1 (Weighbridge): Rejects PO variance exceeding ±0.5% net weight tolerance.
Gate 2 (Row-Lock): Blocks concurrent issue exceeding live uncommitted balances.
Gate 3 (CAG Norm): Trimming spoilage >3.5% requires directorate inquiry justification.
Gate 4 (Dual-Signoff): Requester cannot sanction own indent (Strict RBAC segregation).
Gate 5 (Closed-Loop PoD): Transit status closes only upon verified recipient mobile sign-off.

State A: Low-Stock Condition Detected

When stock drops below threshold (e.g., Judicial Stamp Paper < 15%), an automated alert fires on the dashboard and SMS notification is queued.

CRITICAL ALERT: STP-100-01 has 8 reams left (Minimum ROL: 50). Outward issue blocked for non-emergency indents.

State B: Inward Restock & Alert Auto-Clearing

Upon authorized GRN creation (+100 reams received from Security Mill), stock balance recalculates to 108 reams and the warning clears immediately.

RESTOCK VERIFIED: GRN-2026-0814 posted. Balance 108 reams. Alert cleared. Normal department indents unblocked.
